candidates.change_summary: Replace the target address with a different hardcoded address so that the external call sends value to a different contract, changing the observable state of the target contract.
Delete the external call to target, so no value is forwarded and the contract retains all received value, changing the balance observable at the target contract.
Delete the require statement after the external call, so the function no longer reverts on call failure, potentially leaving this contract with a non-zero balance that is later transferred to owner.
Delete the transfer of the contract balance to owner, so the value sent via msg.value and any leftover balance remains locked in the contract, changing the observable balance of the contract.
Replace the transfer amount with a fixed value of 0, so the owner receives nothing and the contract retains the balance, changing its observable state.
Replace the call value with a fixed value of 0, so no ether is forwarded to the target, leaving more ether in the contract to be transferred to the owner.
Replace the target of the transfer from owner to msg.sender, so the contract balance goes to the caller instead of the stored owner, changing the final balance of the owner.
Move the transfer statement before the external call, so the owner receives the full msg.value before any is forwarded, changing the final balances.
